name: Lampertheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged in the upper third with the city arms of Lampertheim (a white saltire between yellow stars on black).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality by the Ministry of the Interior on 8 February 1951 and is described as red-white-red (1:1:1) striped with the arms in the upper third.

features.role: Lampertheim arms — saltire and stars on black
